archived.info: Not all replays available on Microsoft servers. Older games get removed frequently. Check recordGame field before attempting download.
MS rate limit: 2s delay between downloads is stable. 0.5s causes 429 after ~7 requests. Retry backoff: 5s/10s/15s on 429.
Player disambiguation: WorldsEdge search returns multiple players with same name. search_player picks most active (games+rating). 4 'Urubu' players found, correct one auto-selected.
archived.source: Urubu test — Bruno confirmed correct player

archived.info: Scouting data priority: 1v1 RM first. If n<5, complement with team games + tag '⚠️ Inclui dados TG (amostra 1v1: n=X)'. Team data is noisier (pocket/flank roles, negotiated civs).

Dual-bound housing: lower (heuristic 2+ houses) + upper (pop timeline - deaths). Reports MUST show range. Parser is unified (parser.py), but PDF renderers are separate (pdf_report.py, pdf_analysis.py, pdf_scouting.py) — all must consume the same housing fields.
archived.context: Bruno: toda evolução deve ser aplicada a implementações similares. Engine unificado, reports separados. Match report pós-jogo precisa ganhar mesmas métricas do scouting.

archived.info: PDF engine unification planned: extract shared render logic (KPI cards, chart grids, text sections) into pdf_engine.py + template configs per report type. Do AFTER housing dual-bound is closed.
archived.context: Bruno confirmou: sistema de PDF é exatamente o mesmo, só muda fonte e contexto. Unificar depois do housing.

archived.info: Scouting aggregates use winsorized mean (replaces trimmed mean) to reduce outlier distortion in small samples. Applied in scouting_report.py and pdf_scouting.py.
TC idle classified into three categories: micro (short gaps), macro (long gaps), AFK (very long gaps). Housing bounds cross-validated against TC idle to detect measurement conflicts.
Scouting PDF enriched with real API ELO ratings via profile_id param. Charts split by 1v1/TG with star markers for TG and diamond markers for 1v1/TG indicators in match breakdown subtitle.
